name: app-store-google-play-data-scraper
title: App Store & Google Play Competitor Monitor
description: Search, look up, and monitor Apple App Store and Google Play apps. Track versions, prices, ratings, installs, update dates, and change history across scheduled US or global app portfolios.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

app-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean non-personal app metadata record saved to the dataset.
